newsitem.title: USA: Applied Cellular sees $75 mln in 1997 revs.
newsitem.headline: Applied Cellular sees $75 mln in 1997 revs.

text.p: Applied Cellular Technology Inc said it expects its computer group to contribute more than $30 million of Applied's expected 1997 revenues of $75 million.

The computer group includes recently acquired Pizzaro Re-Marketing Inc, Norcom Resources Inc, and 80-percent-owned Universal Commodities Inc, which rebuilds and re-markets computers, monitors, printers, modems, terminals, mainframes and telephone systems.
In 1996 Applied Cellular reported revenues of $20 million.
Separately, Universal Commodities hired John Janeway, a former product manager at International Business Machines Corp, to head its personal computer division.
Applied Cellular is a specialty telecommunications and high-technology company.
